source: tests/fixtures/skill_queries.json - skills embedded from app/server/serve.py SKILLS (30 builtins) at generation time; labels are hand-written, not model-generated.
note: Queries target one skill each as a human would read the 30 descriptions. Entries flagged "hard" paraphrase with weak lexical overlap; three of them miss top-1 in the current index (measured) and stay in the fixture as an honest record of the lexical ceiling. Genuinely ambiguous pairs (two skills a human could defend) were excluded from this scored set on purpose.
